glossEn: (criminal law) an act punishable by law; usually considered an evil act
note: (criminal law) an act punishable by law; usually considered an evil act。线索：commit a crime / war / violent + crime。关键：受法律惩罚。

glossZh: 罪恶（道德上的恶，不必然违法）
glossEn: an evil act not necessarily punishable by law
note: an evil act not necessarily punishable by law。与 s1 的分界是「是否受法律惩罚」：greed 在中文可说成罪恶，但英语不叫 crime。判别句：Murder is a crime, but greed is only a sin.
